prompt:
The snippet snippets/search-form-labels-5.liquid renders a store search form: a label, a search input with placeholder, a reset button with a close icon, a submit button with a search icon, and an optional list of popular search terms where the first item gets the class search__term--first and the last item gets search__term--last. Several literal references are broken and Theme Check reports errors. Fix every broken reference so it points to the real theme files supplied (assets/, snippets/, locales/en.default.json and locales/fr.json). Do not create or edit any other file and keep the markup and the forloop.first / forloop.last class logic unchanged.

Required references in the fixed snippet:
- Stylesheet: the existing asset component-search.css via asset_url | stylesheet_tag.
- Script: keep the existing asset predictive-search.js loaded with defer.
- Label text: translation key general.search.search.
- Input placeholder: translation key general.search.placeholder.
- Reset button aria-label: translation key general.search.reset, and the button renders the existing snippet icon-close.
- Submit button aria-label: translation key general.search.submit, and the button renders the existing snippet icon-search.
- Popular terms heading: translation key general.search.popular.

Inputs (top-level, never under section.settings): form_id (string), terms (string, may be null or empty), popular_terms (array of strings, may be empty). The fixed file must produce no Theme Check errors. Change only snippets/search-form-labels-5.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
